evidence.quotation: น้ำมันเตา 1500 กำมะถันไม่เกิน 2%
evidence.source: EPPO price-structure workbook, sheet โครงสร้างราคาน้ำมัน
evidence.statement: The official workbook carries a Thai companion sheet whose product rows are formula-bound to the English sheet. Both English label forms are bound to one identical Thai product name, and that name carries no ordinal marker.

In every variant-label document the Thai row's price cells are the formula ='Oil Price Structure'!C15, pointing at the exact cell that carries the English variant label. The publisher's own formula binds the ordinal-free Thai product name to the ordinal-free English row.
unit header is ['UNIT: BAHT/LITRE', 'UNIT:BAHT/LITRE'] in every document
price-stage header is ['EX-REFIN.'] in every document
product number 1500 in both label forms
sulphur grade 2%S in both label forms
neighbours [('FO 600  2%S', 'LPG (BAHT/KILOGRAM)')] match the ordinal era pattern
no valid document carries both forms
'FO 1500 2%S' occupies 2024-07-23..2024-10-28 and 'FO 1500 (2) 2%S' resumes immediately afterwards
excise/municipal/fund columns identical across both eras: 5 distinct patterns
Prices either side of the boundary are close. Recorded for completeness; it carries no weight in the decision, because a different product at the same table position would look the same.
